prompt: In a watercolor illustration of a train dining car, a woman in a blue hat sits on the left side of the frame. Next to her, a silver teapot rests on the table, its spout angled toward the center. A man in a red scarf occupies the center seat, leaning forward slightly as he looks at a menu held by a waiter in a white apron standing to his right. The waiter points at a specific dish on the page while handing a glass of water to an elderly lady in a green coat seated on the far right. There is no window visible in the background, focusing all attention on the intimate dining arrangement. The soft washes of color blend the figures gently into the warm interior, highlighting the distinct positions of the five entities without distraction from exterior views or additional clutter.
